content.question: What is true about PCA's principal components?
options: Each component captures exactly the same amount of variance.
They are correlated with each other to preserve more information.
The last component captures the most variance in the data.
They are orthogonal (uncorrelated), and the first component captures the most variance, followed by the second, third and so on.
content.answer: They are orthogonal (uncorrelated), and the first component captures the most variance, followed by the second, third and so on.
